entries.title: Psalms 66:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. A Song: a Psalm.>> Shout aloud unto God, all the earth:

entries.title: Psalms 66:2
segments: Sing forth the glory of his name, make his praise glorious;

entries.title: Psalms 66:3
segments: Say unto God, How terrible are thy works! because of the greatness of thy strength, thine enemies come cringing unto thee.

entries.title: Psalms 66:4
segments: All the earth shall worship thee, and sing psalms unto thee: they shall sing forth thy name. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 66:5
segments: Come and see the works of God: he is terrible in [his] doings toward the children of men.

entries.title: Psalms 66:6
segments: He turned the sea into dry [land]; they went through the river on foot: there did we rejoice in him.

entries.title: Psalms 66:7
segments: He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes observe the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 66:8
segments: ¶Bless our God, ye peoples, and make the voice of his praise to be heard;

entries.title: Psalms 66:9
segments: Who hath set our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.

entries.title: Psalms 66:10
segments: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.

entries.title: Psalms 66:11
segments: Thou broughtest us into a net, thou didst lay a heavy burden upon our loins;

entries.title: Psalms 66:12
segments: Thou didst cause men to ride over our head; we went through fire and through water: but thou hast brought us out into abundance.

entries.title: Psalms 66:13
segments: ¶I will go into thy house with burnt-offerings; I will perform my vows to thee,

entries.title: Psalms 66:14
segments: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 66:15
segments: I will offer up unto thee burnt-offerings of fatted beasts, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 66:16
segments: Come, hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 66:17
segments: I called unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.

entries.title: Psalms 66:18
segments: Had I regarded iniquity in my heart, the Lord would not hear.

entries.title: Psalms 66:19
segments: But God hath heard; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.

entries.title: Psalms 66:20
segments: Blessed be God, who hath not turned away my prayer, nor his loving-kindness from me!
